video_title: 2026 Hornets Training Camp Media Availability: Moussa Diabate

quotes.speaker: Moussa Diabate
quotes.summary_phrase: Moussa Diabate on the atmosphere at Hornets training camp
quotes.excerpt: we kind of used to it, we've been playing for a little bit now

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Moussa, wrapping up camp here in Charleston. You guys did a lot of live scrimmaging. What was the atmosphere like for you guys?

text_blocks.speaker: Moussa Diabate
text_blocks.text: It was great. We are used to it, we've been playing for a little bit now, so it's not our first time really. But it was great, it was good.

quotes.social_post: Moussa Diabate reflects on the Hornets training camp in Charleston, noting the team is getting used to the intensity of live scrimmaging.

quotes.speaker: Moussa Diabate
quotes.summary_phrase: Moussa Diabate on building team chemistry and cohesion
quotes.excerpt: we have a group of young guys trying to focus on playing together

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: You guys did a lot of runs in the summer. Do you feel some of that chemistry and cohesiveness that you built back a few months ago manifesting here in Charleston?

text_blocks.speaker: Moussa Diabate
text_blocks.text: Yeah, for sure, definitely. I think that's something that we've been really trying to emphasize. Obviously, we have a group of young guys trying to focus on playing together and to play with each other. Especially with me, for me, big to guards, understanding what's on your tendencies on new guards and trying to figure out how to maximize their potential and help me maximize my potential, right? So, yeah, for sure.

quotes.social_post: Moussa Diabate says the Hornets are focused on building chemistry, specifically emphasizing the need for bigs to understand their guards to help maximize potential for everyone on the floor.

quotes.speaker: Moussa Diabate
quotes.summary_phrase: Moussa Diabate's outlook on the upcoming Hornets season
quotes.excerpt: I'm a firm believer that we're going to do some great things

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Overall, what did you think about this week in Charleston for you guys and how you were able to accomplish what you did?

text_blocks.speaker: Moussa Diabate
text_blocks.text: It was good, it was great. I think it's going to be a very long season. It's going to be a lot of ups and downs and for me, I'm just very excited to be with that group. I think we got a chance to really surprise a lot of people and I'm a firm believer that we're going to do some great things.

quotes.social_post: Moussa Diabate is optimistic about the Hornets upcoming season, stating he is a firm believer that the group has a chance to surprise a lot of people.

quotes.speaker: Moussa Diabate
quotes.summary_phrase: Moussa Diabate on his approach to training camp
quotes.excerpt: I'm still looking at it the same way I was looking at it when I first came in

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Early in your career, you came into camp as a second-round guy on a two-way contract. At this point in your career, you're a little bit more established. How has your approach to training camp changed, if at all, as you get further and deeper into your NBA career?

text_blocks.speaker: Moussa Diabate
text_blocks.text: It didn't change. I think I have the same perspective. At the end of the day, I haven't really accomplished nothing, you know? I'm still looking at it the same way I was looking at it when I first came in, trying to prove something. I think at the end of the day, that's the only way to do it, right? I want to play as hard as I can, trying to get better each and every day and yeah, really that's the whole point. So it doesn't change.

quotes.social_post: Despite being more established in the league, Moussa Diabate says his approach to training camp has not changed because he feels he has not accomplished anything yet and is still trying to prove himself.

quotes.speaker: Moussa Diabate
quotes.summary_phrase: Moussa Diabate evaluates the performance of Hornets rookies
quotes.excerpt: they've been on point, on time, listening, I think that's the most important part

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Lastly, how do you think the rookies did? Hannes, Christian, two-way guys, how do you think they did in their first NBA training camp this week?

text_blocks.speaker: Moussa Diabate
text_blocks.text: They did great. They did great. Nothing to say. They've been on point, on time, listening, I think that's the most important part, right? Be able to don't get mad, don't get frustrated by anything that happens, just play the game and just listen to the coaches and whatever the guys have to say and trying to apply it. So, yeah, I'm very excited for them and very happy.

quotes.social_post: Moussa Diabate praises the Hornets rookies and two-way players for their performance in training camp, highlighting their ability to listen and apply coaching.
